changelog:
Initial release of Coding Contract Generator.

- Generates language-agnostic coding contracts (spec.md) from requirements.
- Outputs interface signatures, behavioral constraints, and verification checklists—never implementation code.
- Enforces mandatory constraint and test sections for every interface.
- Includes a structured workflow for requirements clarification, context analysis, spec generation, and self-validation.
- Designed for the "strong model writes spec, weak model writes code" workflow, supporting reuse across any tech stack.
